authority_boundary.legacy_reference: rogal_core.daemon.ROGALDaemon and rogal_core.autonomous_cycle.AutonomousCycle remain the deployed reference runtime.
authority_boundary.kraken_candidate: The deterministic Kraken-R cycle, read-only recorded-execution replay, bounded in-memory signal propagation, advisory bounded physiology, settlement-grounded bounded route preference, grounded bounded adaptive reducers, immutable replayable dynamical ticks, immutable task-integrity inspection, disposable isolated Orzhaal experiments, proposal-only LLM adapter, verified bounded execution observer, and static interaction validation are executable candidate infrastructure only; they have no authority over the deployed runtime.
authority_boundary.preservation: Legacy, alternate, dormant, and forgotten mechanisms are classified and preserved, never deleted by this foundation.

mechanisms.name: Kraken-R constitutional foundation
mechanisms.intended_role: Candidate-only vocabulary, architecture census, and inspection boundary.
mechanisms.notes: No runtime loop, writer, subscriber, or actuator is provided.

mechanisms.name: Deterministic constitutional cycle
mechanisms.intended_role: Execute one bounded candidate objective through observed evidence, settlement, learning, and an explicit stop.
mechanisms.notes: Pure in-memory candidate fixture; it never imports or mutates the legacy runtime.

mechanisms.name: Recorded-execution constitutional replay
mechanisms.intended_role: Replay one immutable observed execution record through the candidate cycle without live runtime access.
mechanisms.notes: Pure in-memory adapter: immutable records are validated for identity, state version, provenance, and observed evidence before replay; no EventBus, router, store, or legacy import is used.

mechanisms.name: Round-three salvage decision record
mechanisms.intended_role: Preserve the refinement-trace disposition and non-promotion blockers for nervous-system salvage candidates.
mechanisms.notes: The deleted refinement traces remain in Git history and are intentionally not restored; legacy nervous-system mechanisms remain preserved and quarantined from candidate authority until their recorded blockers are resolved.

mechanisms.name: Bounded deterministic candidate signal propagation
mechanisms.intended_role: Propagate canonical declared signals through fixed candidate-only rules with task-state/provenance, source/cause, and priority binding; TTL, stable deduplication, supported-topic rejection, finite budgets, and explicit inhibition or amplification.
mechanisms.notes: Pure in-memory candidate infrastructure. It extends the canonical Signal/Event alias rather than creating a second transport authority; signals are declared messages, never evidence or truth. Candidate delivery requires explicit source, cause, and integer priority; equal-tick delivery orders higher priority first and then signal_id, while unknown topics reject before delivery. Rules are static and deterministic: no learning, persistence, subscriptions, adaptive selection, or legacy imports.

mechanisms.name: Bounded advisory candidate physiology
mechanisms.intended_role: Evaluate one explicit immutable internal-condition snapshot and conservatively inhibit a candidate action during recovery or critical operating regimes.
mechanisms.notes: Pure in-memory adapter of normalized pressure, threshold/hysteresis, contradiction/backlog, and protected-reserve concepts. It imports no legacy mechanism and has no live sensor, queue, router, evidence, settlement, learning, persistence, lifecycle, or goal-selection authority. Its only allowed effect is an explicit, replayable candidate-action inhibition before fixture execution.

mechanisms.name: Settlement-grounded bounded candidate route preference
mechanisms.intended_role: Select a deterministic candidate organizational edge and apply a fixed bounded preference adjustment only after one provenance-bound constitutional settlement with grounded execution evidence.
mechanisms.notes: Pure immutable reducer, not a router or controller. It adapts bounded strengthening/weakening, route topology, auditable pathway lineage, and reset concepts while rejecting legacy stores, globals, clocks, background loops, signal confidence, broad credit assignment, and cross-run persistence. Only settled task_success/task_failure with matching verified child-runtime, record, and execution-class provenance may adjust the selected route by a fixed bounded delta; setup/infrastructure, timeout/resource, execution, contradiction, insufficient-evidence, declared claims, stale selections, malformed provenance, and duplicate in-window settlements fail closed or explicitly withhold learning.

mechanisms.name: Grounded bounded candidate adaptive substrate
mechanisms.intended_role: Apply deterministic, local, generation-bounded route, connection, rollback, and tactic adjustments only after an independently reverified grounded constitutional settlement.
mechanisms.notes: Pure caller-owned immutable reducer. Every ordinary update stores the exact creditable task_success/task_failure class and requires matching independently verified child-runtime, request, record, provenance, authorized state, and evidence hashes. Later grounded task failure can invalidate one retained prior reinforcement by restoring its bounded pre-update checkpoint while retaining both identities; fixed route caps, stale-selection rejection, rollback, decay/recovery, and tactic-streak escape prevent monopoly and lock-in. Setup/infrastructure, timeout/resource, execution, contradiction, and insufficient-evidence classes cannot earn credit, form topology, alter tactics, invalidate evidence, or affect homeostasis. Signals, physiology, confidence, and declared model output cannot earn credit. The substrate has no dispatch, execution, persistence, subscription, goal-selection, controller, or live runtime authority.

mechanisms.name: Disposable Orzhaal adaptation-rule experiment boundary
mechanisms.intended_role: Compare one bounded adaptation-rule variation against an immutable forked candidate state without promotion or canonical mutation.
mechanisms.notes: An Orzhaal result is structured disposable experiment output only. It has no canonical write, promotion, evidence, settlement, learning, topology, provider, runtime, or persistent-state authority; adaptation of adaptation rules remains excluded from Kraken-R ordinary operation.

mechanisms.name: Bounded immutable replayable dynamical substrate
mechanisms.intended_role: Reduce explicitly supplied bounded event batches through immutable fast activation/inhibition/surprise, approved medium adaptive state, and non-authoritative slow coherence observations.
mechanisms.notes: A pure caller-owned transition function over explicit event records; it has no clock, scheduler, daemon, bus, subscriber, persistence, executor, provider, primitive creation, topology authority, or promotion path. Declared signals and typed mismatch observations only affect bounded fast state and advisory endogenous physiology. The only medium-state changes reuse the pre-existing independently verified settlement gates exactly. Stage 10.9 can compare matched full and explicitly ablated immutable runs, but its trace-derived measurements are descriptive only and cannot create evidence, credit, topology authority, or a criticality target. Infrastructure, timeout/resource, execution, contradiction, insufficient-evidence, and inhibited outcomes retain provenance but cannot reshape routes, tactics, connections, homeostasis, or learning. Slow coherence is instrumentation only.

mechanisms.name: Bounded immutable task-integrity boundary
mechanisms.intended_role: Preserve an original task through a bounded structured specification, declared competing hypotheses, information-loss accounting, and selectively invoked proposal-only adversarial review.
mechanisms.notes: Pure immutable inspection only. Original task text, structured clause identities, hypotheses, plan, candidate result, loss findings, and role-specific minimal projections remain caller-owned and replayable. Angel, Nemesis, and Antimetabole findings are proposal-only verification questions; they cannot create evidence, settlement, authority, topology credit, adaptive changes, persistence, provider routing, execution, or durable memory. Infrastructure, timeout/resource, execution, contradiction, ambiguity, and insufficient-evidence outcomes remain non-creditable.

mechanisms.name: Controlled candidate LLM proposal adapter and held-out evaluator
mechanisms.intended_role: Request one bounded typed proposal/reasoning declaration from an injected model provider, record structural provenance, and compare base, mediated, and reset-routing conditions without granting the model authority.
mechanisms.notes: Stateless injected-provider leaf with strict proposal/reasoning/route-hint JSON only. Inputs are bound to a cycle task state; outputs are declared-only and cannot become evidence, settlement, goal, persistence, execution, controller state, or learning credit. Provider identity and model provenance are bound to the injected request; enforced deadlines, provider errors, malformed output, self-report fields, invalid provenance, and out-of-bound route hints fail closed. Generation is marked nondeterministic while input/output hashes and structural replay (including received malformed output) are deterministic. The evaluator holds task, model configuration, provider identity, template, temperature, and output budget fixed across base, mediated, and reset-routing conditions, checks normalized prompt length and available provider-reported input-token counts, reports descriptive observed deltas, and never makes a performance claim.

mechanisms.name: Static bounded interaction validation
mechanisms.intended_role: Validate caller-supplied immutable candidate traces across inhibition, grounded execution, settlement, route credit, delivery order, replay, and declared model provenance.
mechanisms.notes: Stateless acceptance validator only. It owns no live main-instance responsibility and cannot run code, contact providers, mutate topology, persist receipts, dispatch signals, retry work, or promote a capability. The legacy daemon and AutonomousCycle retain all live lifecycle, bus, store, queue, controller, executor, actuator, and promotion responsibilities; later-stage recursive, specialist, lattice, organ, evolution, chemistry, HOP, Redstone, and alternate reasoning mechanisms remain quarantined or planned-only.
